title: Daily set · Nov 25
title_zh: 每日新题 · 11 月 25 日
summary: Five new agent questions: recording and replaying agent runs to debug a wrong deletion, server-side request forgery through a URL-fetching tool, an eval set that missed a new product line, a batch read tool instead of 40 calls, and keeping one merchant's bulk job from rate-limiting everyone's live chat.
summary_zh: 五道新的 Agent 题：通过录制与回放来调试一次删错的操作、借抓取 URL 的工具实施的服务端请求伪造、漏掉新产品线的评测集、用批量读取工具代替 40 次调用，以及防止一个商家的批量任务让所有人的实时聊天被限流。

questions.title: A merchant says the agent deleted the wrong discount yesterday, and nobody can reproduce it: building record and replay for agent runs
questions.title_zh: 商家说 Agent 昨天删错了一个折扣，可谁都复现不出来：为 Agent 运行构建录制与回放
questions.question:
A merchant asked the store assistant to "remove the Black Friday VIP discount", and it deleted the public Black Friday code instead. The team reran the same request against a staging copy and the agent did the right thing every time. The logs keep the final reply and a list of tool names, but not the tool inputs or results. Leadership asks what happened and how to make the next incident debuggable.

Explain why rerunning did not help and design the fix.
questions.question_zh:
一位商家让店铺助手「删除黑五 VIP 折扣」，结果它删掉的是公开的黑五折扣码。团队在预发环境的副本上重跑同一个请求，Agent 每次都做对了。日志只保留了最终回复和一串工具名称，没有工具的输入和结果。管理层想知道发生了什么，以及怎样让下一次事故可以被调试。

解释为什么重跑没有帮助，并设计修复方案。
followups: How long would you keep recordings, and who may read them?
How would you turn a recorded incident into a regression test that stays useful after tools change?
followups_zh: 录制内容你会保留多久？谁可以查看？
你会如何把一次录制下来的事故变成回归测试，并在工具变化后依然有用？

questions.title: The product-import agent fetches any URL a merchant pastes, and a security researcher makes it read the cloud metadata service
questions.title_zh: 商品导入 Agent 会抓取商家粘贴的任意 URL，一位安全研究员借此让它读取了云元数据服务
questions.question:
Merchants can say "import products from this supplier page" and paste a link. The agent calls a custom `fetch_url` tool that runs in the import service and returns the page text. A researcher pasted a link to an internal address, and the agent returned data from the cloud provider's metadata endpoint. A second attempt used a public domain that redirected to an internal address and also worked.

Explain the vulnerability and fix it.
questions.question_zh:
商家可以说「从这个供应商页面导入商品」，并粘贴一个链接。Agent 会调用一个自定义的 `fetch_url` 工具，它运行在导入服务里，返回页面文本。一位研究员粘贴了一个指向内网地址的链接，Agent 返回了云厂商元数据端点的数据。第二次尝试用了一个会重定向到内网地址的公网域名，同样成功了。

解释这个漏洞，并修复它。
followups: How would you test the fetcher against DNS rebinding?
Which other agent tools in your system make outbound requests on the model's behalf?
followups_zh: 你会如何测试这个抓取器能否抵御 DNS 重绑定？
你的系统里还有哪些 Agent 工具会代表模型发起出站请求？

questions.title: The support agent passes every eval after launching subscriptions, while subscription questions fill the escalation queue
questions.title_zh: 上线订阅功能后，客服 Agent 通过了所有评测，而订阅相关的问题却塞满了转人工队列
questions.question:
The platform launched subscription products last month. The support agent's eval suite, built last spring from real tickets, still passes at the usual level after every prompt change. Meanwhile, the escalation queue is full of questions like "how do I skip next month's box" and "why was I charged twice for my plan", which the agent answers badly.

Why did the eval miss this, and how should the eval set stay current?
questions.question_zh:
平台上个月上线了订阅类商品。客服 Agent 的评测集是去年春天基于真实工单建立的，每次修改提示词后，它仍然以往常的水平通过。与此同时，转人工队列里塞满了「怎么跳过下个月的盒子」「为什么我的订阅被扣了两次款」这类问题，而 Agent 回答得很糟糕。

评测为什么漏掉了这些？评测集应当如何保持与时俱进？
followups: How would you classify intents in production without sending all conversations to a human?
What should block a prompt change from shipping: the overall score or a per-intent score?
followups_zh: 你会如何在不把所有对话都交给人工的情况下，对生产环境中的意图进行分类？
应该由什么来阻止一次提示词变更上线：总分，还是按意图的分数？

questions.title: "Which of my 40 bestsellers are out of stock?" makes the agent call get_product 40 times, filling the context with full product records
questions.title_zh: 「我的 40 个畅销品里哪些缺货了？」让 Agent 调用了 40 次 get_product，上下文里塞满了完整的商品记录
questions.question:
The merchant assistant has a `get_product(id)` tool that returns the full product: title, description, variants, images, SEO fields and inventory. For a question about 40 products, the agent makes 40 calls, the context grows by tens of thousands of tokens of descriptions nobody needed, and answers get slower and more expensive. Sometimes the agent gives up halfway and answers from the first 20.

Redesign the tool.
questions.question_zh:
商家助手有一个 `get_product(id)` 工具，它返回完整的商品：标题、描述、变体、图片、SEO 字段和库存。对于一个涉及 40 个商品的问题，Agent 会调用 40 次，上下文增加了几万个没人需要的描述 token，回答变得更慢也更贵。有时 Agent 做到一半就放弃了，只根据前 20 个来回答。

重新设计这个工具。
followups: How would you decide the default fields a batch tool returns when the model does not ask for any?
When would you prefer programmatic tool calling over adding a new tool?
followups_zh: 当模型没有指定字段时，你会如何决定批量工具默认返回哪些字段？
什么时候你会选择程序化工具调用，而不是新增一个工具？

questions.title: One merchant's bulk description job uses the whole Claude rate limit, and live shopper chat for every other store starts getting 429s
questions.title_zh: 一个商家的批量商品描述任务用光了整个 Claude 速率限额，其他所有店铺的顾客实时聊天开始收到 429
questions.question:
All AI features share one Claude organization. On Monday morning a large merchant started regenerating descriptions for 80,000 products. Within minutes, the shopper chat assistant for every other store began failing with rate-limit errors, and the SDK's automatic retries made it worse. The bulk job itself finished fine.

Design how features and tenants share the capacity.
questions.question_zh:
所有 AI 功能共用一个 Claude 组织。周一早上，一个大商家开始为 8 万个商品重新生成描述。几分钟之内，其他所有店铺的顾客聊天助手都开始因限流错误而失败，SDK 的自动重试让情况更糟。而那个批量任务自己倒是顺利完成了。

设计各功能和各租户如何共享这份容量。
followups: How would you size the interactive reserve, and how would you know it is too small?
A merchant pays for a premium plan with faster bulk jobs. How does your design change?
When would you split traffic across separate API keys or workspaces instead of one shared budget?
followups_zh: 你会如何确定交互流量的预留份额？又如何知道它太小了？
某个商家付费购买了批量任务更快的高级套餐。你的设计要怎么改？
什么时候你会把流量拆到不同的 API key 或 workspace 上，而不是共用一份预算？

vocab.zh: 吵闹的邻居（资源争抢的租户）
